verdict.rationale: Elicit ships a built-in Research Agent. Users hand it tasks in natural language: adding extraction columns, applying filters, exporting sources, saving papers, generating figures and drafting slides, all within the conversation. Delegation is tunable through an effort slider, reusable skills invoked with "/", and Routines that act on findings and write summaries. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the current Research Agent's task delegation (the community reports predate it and cover other features).
